check_names: Every new plot-binding control exists exactly once in actual HTML
Reverse button reverses displayed genes and switches to editable selection order
A–Z button sorts actual symbols without adding or losing genes
Applying display alias trims text and activates custom display only
Selecting alias target loads existing display alias into editor
Reset display alias removes its exact source-keyed entry
Blank alias is ignored without source-label changes
Category Apply uses current field and original unshortened category key
Invalid color cannot replace a valid category override
Category Reset removes only the selected override
Volcano numeric/count/color controls update actual saved settings
Volcano label maximum is clamped to100
Volcano label/threshold checkbox handlers toggle actual settings
Automatic gene checkbox uses actual handler
Expression resolution handler activates cluster mode
Nucleus mode normalizes unsupported summary metric without inventing individual detection fractions
Manual expression ranges, zero color, categorical palette and row-label mode are wired
Every display-handler operation preserves source annotations, coordinates, exact DE members and fit IDs
